title: Pocketwire Rewards Quarterly Milestone Bonus: Entitlement and Crediting Tool
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards quarterly milestone bonus is owed for a calendar quarter once that quarter has ended and its qualifying spend reached the milestone threshold of the tier held on the quarter's last day.

## Entitlement

1. The quarterly milestone bonus is owed for a calendar quarter once that quarter has ended, when the quarter's qualifying spend, the spend carried by earning entries dated in the quarter less the spend carried by clawback entries dated in the quarter, reached the milestone threshold of the tier held on the quarter's last day, and it is booked as one entry carrying the quarter (YYYY-Qn) as its period.
2. A quarterly milestone bonus is credited only if the ledger carries no quarterly milestone bonus entry dated after the last day of the quarter it is for.
3. Bonus points are subject to the tier's pending period like any other earning.

Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.

## Hypothetical quarter

Quarter 2025-Q1 ended on 31 March 2025. On that day the membership held a tier whose milestone threshold is, hypothetically, 3500.00 USD.

| Earning entries in the quarter | Clawback entries in the quarter | Qualifying spend | Milestone reached |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3720.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 3570.00 USD | Yes, period 2025-Q1 |
| 3720.00 USD | 250.00 USD | 3470.00 USD | No |
| 3500.00 USD | none | 3500.00 USD | Yes, the threshold is reached exactly |

- While 2025-Q2 is still running, no bonus is owed for it.
- A quarterly milestone bonus entry dated 10 March 2025 is not dated after 31 March 2025.

## Crediting tool: credit_quarterly_milestone_bonus_7b7b30cf

Situation of use and capability. The tool credits a Pocketwire Rewards quarterly spend milestone bonus to a member's points balance. It books one quarterly milestone bonus entry on the member's points ledger, dated today, for the calendar quarter given, and adds the points to the membership's points balance. The member sees the bonus in the app's points activity and a higher points balance straight away.

How it is invoked. `credit_quarterly_milestone_bonus_7b7b30cf` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

Parameters.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the rewards membership reference number of the member being credited, as returned by the rewards membership lookup | reference number |
| `bonus_period` | the calendar quarter the bonus is for; this tool books quarterly milestone bonuses only | YYYY-Qn: the four-digit year, a hyphen, the letter Q and the quarter number 1 to 4 |
| `points` | the bonus points credited | a whole integer number of points, zero or positive |

Return. A text rendering of a dictionary with `status` (the text "credited" when the entry was booked), `rewards_entry_id` (reference number of the new points entry), `membership_id`, `bonus_type` (always the text "quarterly_milestone"), `bonus_period` (as booked), `points` (integer points credited), `entry_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (the membership's integer points balance including this credit).
